clayresearch.finding: Obey owner-fixed OmniSource: every newly observed available datum enters provenance-bound intake, and every material semantic delta closes through ResearchReentryReceipt into evidence/hypotheses/tests/architecture/work or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE. Add this fusion's observability gate before routing-performance adjudication; do not build a duplicate fusion architecture.
clayresearch.next_experiment: Representative source-class replay with exact source->assessment->route->receiver->reentry closure.

gwt.finding: Under OmniSource, keep delivery -> reconstruction -> use -> research/local effect -> result re-entry explicitly separate. Exposure or connectivity is not causal uptake.
gwt.next_experiment: Receiver/reentry closure with irrelevant, shuffled and broken-provenance controls.

frank.finding: OmniSource changes Research Entity intake/reentry operation, not Frank runtime authority or architecture. Frank remains a separate research subject; self-Harness authority remains proposal-only.
frank.next_experiment: No new Frank architecture test from this fusion beyond existing Harness/OmniSource replay obligations.

emergenz.finding: Owner-fixed all-source intake increases the importance of overcoupling/groupthink controls. Connectivity, repetition and data volume remain non-evidence; lesion dependency propagation, anti-entropy and source-class intake separately.
emergenz.next_experiment: Contradictory/high-centrality source burst with propagation and anti-entropy lesions; measure false interrupts, diversity and evidence-loop amplification.

claycode.finding: Do not reopen BASE semantics for OmniSource/V2/V3 absent executable counterexample. Current critical evidence remains WP03 preservation versus WP04/WP05 legality/disposition/use; concurrent Hypofusion R6 MLIR precedent independently strengthens that separation without prescribing MLIR architecture.
claycode.next_experiment: Per-class WP04/WP05 disposition matrix prioritizing rule_decl/invariant_decl; later compile OmniSource/receipt authority types through the frozen semantics.

hyperposition.finding: Preserve unresolved routing alternatives under OmniSource: current promoted routing, V2 TARGETED/DENSE/DIGEST choices and only non-duplicate V3 supplements remain distinguishable until matched evidence selects among them.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Matched sparse/local versus dense/global invalidations with route uncertainty preserved.

claygraph.finding: OmniSource uses ClayGraph as derived affected-dependency topology; valid routing replay additionally requires the pre-route projection hash/snapshot and explicit stale/missing-edge state. Graph activation never becomes truth or effect authority.
claygraph.next_experiment: Persist/reconstruct pre-route projection; inject missing/stale edges and source-cursor gaps; measure affected-branch recall and repair latency.

unifieddb.finding: Persist OmniSourceObservation/FusionAssessment/ResearchReentryReceipt together with the routing adjudication surfaces: semantic epoch, pre-route projection/hash, causal predecessors, RoutePlan, receiver closure, exact-vs-priority-shadow identity and repair state. Persistence itself grants no truth.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Duplicate distinct-provenance, stale epoch, source-gap, causal reorder and crash/restart replay with coherent-epoch checks.

harness.finding: Run the owner-fixed OmniSource implementation/reentry replay first, then shadow-evaluate V2 routing and only non-duplicate V3 fault mechanisms using identical recorded pre-route state. The 15:56 4-of-9 affected set is a post-hoc oracle baseline only, not V2 validation.
harness.next_experiment: Representative source-class + matched routing/fault/recovery matrix with full metadata and observability receipts.
